text.description_html:
Acorn WIEBP, 24 Inch Warwick Fancy Tip Dummy Strap Hinge

The 24 Inch Fancy Tip Warwick Iron Dummy Strap Hinge give an old world charm to any home door, gate, shutter, or garage door without the need of installing actual hinges. Strap Hinges are a great way to change the look of your doors without having to reinstall all the existing hardware or for when working hinges would be inoperable. Good for interior and exterior doors. The 24 Inch Warwick Fancy Tip Dummy Strap Hinge has a rough black iron finish and a lifetime no-rust warranty. The warwick rough iron duplicates the texture found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the look and feel of natural weathered iron.

Click Here to see the entire Acorn Warwick Tip Collection

Specifications of the Acorn Rough Iron Fancy Tip Dummy Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 24"
  • Max Width: 5"
  • Width at Hinge: 3"
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
